documents.summary: Offers three syllabus templates ranging from restrictive to permissive, plus a College of Business policy and citation formats. It recommends but does not require that instructors set a policy.

documents.unit: Center for Teaching, Learning, and Assessment (CTLA)
documents.title: OHIO Faculty Course AI Policies and Guidelines
tiers: Samples range from encouraged or required AI use to default bans with exceptions
documents.summary: A collection of faculty-written sample course AI policies from many disciplines (chemistry, management, education, sociology, English, music history) plus generic CTLA statements. Permissions vary widely, but the samples share disclosure and responsibility rules.
documents.stance_why: The page publishes 'Sample Syllabi and Policy Statements' by individual faculty, from 'strictly prohibited' answer-generation to AI 'encouraged' and required for projects, so the university sets no stance and leaves it to instructors. Some samples restrict (Chen: 'limited permission'; Rice: 'should not use GenAI tools unless I specify otherwise'), others encourage (Burgraff, Gunderson).
